name: Lenovo Ultraslim Wireless Combo (keyboard)
productString: Lenovo Ultraslim Wireless Combo Keyboard and Mouse
notes: 65-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface of a real Lenovo Ultraslim Wireless Combo, from a libinput record of the device on Linux: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libinput/libinput/uploads/057dfc753cefc3b26159026fe2e667e5/libinput_record. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
